bootstrap.unit: Whole main content bundle: both arrival types, loads and all arms
bootstrap.draw_indices_encoding: Concatenate complete [samples,8] tables in GSM8K-train,WildChat order; little-endian signed int64 C-order; no header
bootstrap.scope: Conditional on selected trace material, content construction, fixed payload mix and one allocation; excludes new-day/deployment variation

confirmatory.hierarchy: Stockoff primary,10guards and date checks gate previous-fused secondary; both hierarchical useful-gain endpoints are required for advance.

scope: Inference on GSM8K-train/WildChat content bundles conditional on selected trace/content and one allocation.
limitations: Previous/fix physical assignment identity is audited separately; no offline routing enters final arms.
Controller tails are post-output extent, not exclusive cost; complete elapsed includes horizon/drain.
Numerics:4,112 whole batches/group against stockoff;64 FP32 positions/group;16 whole postflight batches/trial plus resident-weight checks.
Independent bank/route/lifecycle and statistical audits remain required.
